posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Yeah...it's definitely going through the VisuStella plugins, and I have absolutely no idea why it's calling stuff for the BattleManager when you're not in battle.
I guess you could look in the plugin parameters for the Events & Movement to see if there's something making the timer abort a battle or something weird...but I really have no clue.
And, unfortunately, VisuStella's plugins are obfuscated so we can't just look at the code and see what's being done that shouldn't be.

posts.author: ISC
posts.body:
I see that the timer is contributing to the problem. At the moment, I don't have a way to test the code, so I can only make an educated guess. You could try stopping the timer before the transfer; this way, we can ensure the timer operation has ceased.
So, insert a:
- Timer stop
- wait 1 frame
before the transfer.

Okay, so after another hour or so of fiddling on stream, I figured out a solution. I figured if the system thought I was trying to abort a battle that I wasn’t in, I’d just make it so that it didn’t ‘abort’ that battle. So I built on what ISC said and changed it to look like the below:
By not having the timer end until after the conditional branch, for some reason, it doesn’t glitch out. But I had to set it to 1 second left, wait a frame, then stop the timer. I don’t know why it thought I was trying to abort a battle I was not in, or why it was opening the battle manager at all. But I did find a workaround. It might cause more issues later on, but at least I know how to work around them.
